attributes.description: This dashboard shows Credential Sightings collected by the Flashpoint Integration.

params.markdown:
This dashboard provides centralized visibility into compromised credential sightings discovered by Flashpoint.

Key metrics highlight Total Sightings, Exposed Users, Fresh Credentials, and Infected Hosts. A bar chart tracks Sightings over Time split by freshness, while a pie chart shows Sightings by Source Type. Bar charts list Top Exposed Email Domains and Top Affected Sites, and a table of Top Breaches shows which breaches expose the most credentials.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/ti_flashpoint)**
